what: Generated clips provide motion; a hand-built JavaScript drawing layer is the actual picture, with every frame a pure function of time rendered frame-exactly in a headless browser; both 16:9 and 9:16 modes come from the same film.

Ease with a cubic-bezier (0.645,0.045,0.355,1) over the reveal window, then fade in the end marker and value label.

what: Vector paths rendered through a deterministic capsule-dab brush with edge bias, gaussian softness, tone layers and paper grain to look hand-inked.
how: ink.js capsule dabs of width 2*bias along contours; JS separable gaussian blur (Chromium canvas blur silently no-ops at very small sigma); tone layers at several gray levels for dry-brush; paperGrain opacity; scene modules expose window.renderFrame(t) and are rendered by Playwright into frames then ffmpeg.

what: Decode a reference animation into distinct drawings, trace each to vector paths, re-render, and measure against source (XOR vs codec noise floor, SSIM) to learn a drawn style.
how: Dedup drawings by large-gray-step pixel count not mean diff; threshold at midpoint of ink/paper gray modes; supersample 4x before findContours; approxPolyDP; unsharp mask before trace; overrides JSON per drawing range (bias, blur, sharp, levels, tint). Use for studying styles, never shipping traced third-party geometry.

what: Left-aligned handwritten-style sentence that reveals letter by letter after the full layout is fixed (so text never re-centres while typing), optional underline or hand-drawn circle accent.

what: Turn a rotoscoped reference into numeric style bands (palette, edge softness, stroke width, roughness, boil, holds) and check new animation against them, without copying source geometry.

what: Excalidraw/rough.js-style strokes with controllable wobble and hachure or cross-hatch fills.

params: roughness 0-2; seed fixed; fontFamily 1 hand / 3 mono

what: Trace two-tone ink drawings to polygon paths with holes so they can be re-rendered or animated as vectors.

params: supersample S=4; unsharp then blur sigma ~0.85px

name_en: Deterministic ink brush engine on canvas
what: Paths are rendered through capsule dabs, separable gaussian blur, optional paper grain and tone layers so the same input yields identical pixels.

params: blur floor 0.8px; grain off for faithful copy

what: Draw a complete country border (many rings/islands) as one timed stroke by cumulative length, without inventing joins.
how: Store each segment line, its length and cumulative start; for a reveal window [from,to] km slice every overlapping segment and emit a MultiLineString; skip slivers under 0.0008 km; never clip the border to the viewport (it may leave frame naturally).

what: Shape carries meaning: fan-out, convergence, tree, cycle, cloud, assembly line, side-by-side, gap, lines as structure.

Timelines as a line with 10-20 px dots and free labels; trees as trunk+branch lines; assembly line chaos->process->order. Excalidraw JSON with roughness 0-2 gives a hand-drawn look and can be rendered to PNG then animated (draw-on of strokes).
params: roughness 0 smooth / 1 default / 2 rough; timeline dots 10-20 px

name_en: Continuous-line logo story (one stroke → three beats → wordmark loop)
what: خط واحد لا ينقطع يمر بثلاث محطات مرقّمة ثم يلتف حول الشعار، مع صوت مولّد بالكود. / One unbroken line travels through three numbered beats and closes into a loop around the wordmark, with code-synthesised sound.
how: 13 waypoints interpolated 18 steps each; drawn length = smoothstep(t/4.1); beat dots grow with smoothstep((t−(0.9+0.85k))/0.55) and their labels (01 CAPTURE, 02 CONNECT, 03 RESURFACE) appear at the same instants; from 4.25 s an ellipse (rx 100, ry 42) draws over 1.1 s around the wordmark. Editorial palette: paper (246,241,230), ink (31,36,34), one accent (213,70,48), 6 px stroke, pen-tip dot. Audio generated in NumPy (see BEAT-P01). Re-ran here: 6.000 s, 360×640, 24 fps, H.264 + AAC 96k.
